resources.string: Charging is held off by this app
The node could not be read on this device
Pausing charging writes a kernel node that the shell uid may not touch. Start the privileged service as root to use this.
While charging is paused the phone stays plugged in without charging. Resume it here before you unplug or reboot, or the battery will keep draining on the charger.
The ROM battery protection is active as well. Two mechanisms aiming at the same hardware will fight each other, so pick one.
This is a manual switch. Nothing is scheduled and nothing runs in the background.
Clears the collected battery statistics so the next overnight drain report starts clean. Needs no root and changes no hardware state.
